description: This file defines classes and structures related to the storage environment for testing relational database systems within the Orleans framework. It includes data models for storage connections and environment settings, as well as invariants and utility methods to ensure storage readiness and environment consistency for tests.

classes.name: StorageConnection
classes.description: Represents a storage connection with invariant name and connection string.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentSettings
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration settings for the test environment, including storage connections and environment ID.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentInvariant
classes.description: Enforces environment invariants for testing, manages default and active settings, ensures storage and emulator readiness, and handles settings merging.

methods.name: EnsureStorageForTesting
methods.description: Ensures the storage designated by the connection is functional and returns a storage testing object.

methods.name: EnsureEmulatorStorageForTesting
methods.description: Tries to start the storage emulator for testing purposes.

methods.name: TryLoadAndMergeWithCustomSettings
methods.description: Loads custom settings from a file if present and merges them with default settings.

methods.name: CanConnectToStorage
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a given storage connection is reachable and operational.
